info.description: Safety bands, the security plan's markers, and the emergency procedure. Mirrors apps/web/src/data/campus.ts. ⚠ THE FIVE BAND HEADS — timeline, plan, transport, wellbeing, surveillance — are the eyebrow, heading and standfirst of each band on /campus/safety-security/, in page order. kicker = the eyebrow; the FIRST paragraph of body = the standfirst. ⚠ NOT EDITABLE HERE, on purpose: the section-rail labels and anchors (tied to DOM ids), the plan's zoom buttons and its 'Select a point on the plan.' empty state — interface, not content. ⚠ `transportFigures` ARE THE THREE COUNTS under the transport band — fleet size, routes, and the tracked proportion. They are TYPED, not computed: the fleet figure (29+) is larger than the number of distinct vehicles on the published routes (22), so deriving them from Bus Route would silently republish a different number. If the fleet changes, edit it here AND check the band's standfirst, which states the route count in words.
